Free Online Business Tools

Explore Tooleefy's curated directory of high-integrity, completely free online business and productivity tools. Invoice Tools

Our **Free Invoice Generator** is designed to simplify professional billing. Customize sender and client parameters, upload your business logo, configure local taxes or discounts, and export beautiful client-ready PDFs. Every financial calculation is handled locally inside your browser window.

QR Code Tools

Leverage our **Free QR Code Generator** to create custom branded, highly scanable QR codes. Customize dots, markers, and colors, embed custom company logos in the center, or execute high-speed bulk QR code generation using plain text or URL CSV spreadsheet lists.

Barcode Tools

Speed up retail, tracking, and warehousing workflows with our **Free Barcode Generator**. Easily render logistics-grade barcodes (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC) individually, or upload CSV rosters to pack hundreds of SKU code labels into a neat, downloadable ZIP archive.

Unit Conversion Tools

Access our **Free Unit Converter Online** to perform fast, scientific conversions across major physical measurement categories—including length, weight, mass, temperature, area, volume, and digital units with certified precision.

Our Commitment to Local Sovereignty

At Tooleefy, we believe you shouldn't have to surrender your business privacy for modern web convenience. Every utility listed in our business directory operates on secure, local-first browser architectures. No invoices, customer email lists, product inventory data sheets, or tracking URLs are ever transmitted to our servers.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Do I need to sign up for an account to use these tools?

No, all tools are immediately available for use. We have eliminated all login blocks, email requests, and paywalls so you can work friction-free.

Is there any limit on bulk generation tasks?

None. Our bulk engines run locally in your browser memory, meaning we place zero artificial limits or daily quotas on your spreadsheet processing tasks.
